description:
Timber Window Replacement
-	Removal of existing timber box sash window or casement window
-	Installation of new timber box sash window or casement window to corresponding opening
-	Sashes to slide vertically, hung traditionally on cords & weights
-	Casements to open outward
-	New box sash or casement frame will be insulated using a thermal grade expanding foam between the frame & the building
-	New sashes, casements & frames will be sealed & painted using a MVP Acrylic Paint
-	New frames will be sealed to the exterior of the aperture, timber frame to brick using a waterproof concrete fillet or a mastic seal

Specification

-	Sashes, casements & frames to be manufactured using Accoya Wood
-	All new timber is treated for woodworm & other parasites prior to painting
-	All new timber is treated for Dry & Wet Rot prior to painting


Glass to W1, W2 & W3
Krypton filled Double Glazed Unit with 4mm cavity
Inner Pane - 4mm Planitherm Low - E Energy Efficient Coating - Toughened Spacer Bar - 4mm White Warm Edge
Outer Pane - 4mm Low Iron - Toughened

Glass to W4 & W6
Argon filedl Double Glazed Unit with 16mm cavity
Inner Pane - 4mm Planitherm Low - E Energy Efficient Coating - Toughened Spacer Bar - 16mm White Warm Edge
Outer Pane - 6.8mm Laminated acoustic noise control

Glass to W5
Argon filled Double Glazed Unit with 16mm cavity
Inner Pane - 4mm Planitherm Low - E Energy Efficient Coating - Toughened Spacer Bar - 16mm White Warm Edge
Outer Pane - 4mm Low Iron - Toughened

All joinery will be fully finished with a 4 - coat microporous spray applied white paint finish in Magnolia or close varient to the interior & exterior prior to installation
decision_conditions:
The development to which this permission relates must be begun not later than the expiration of three years beginning with the date of this permission.
REASON: To conform with the requirements of Section 91 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 as amended by the Planning and Compulsory Purchase Act 2004.
